cyclingAlerts.alertsSubtitle: Important conditions to be aware of
cyclingAlerts.noAlertsMessage: Conditions look good for cycling. Enjoy your ride!

alerts.rainExpectedDescription: Rain probability exceeds 50% in the next {{count}} hour(s). Consider rain gear or postponing your ride.
alerts.thunderstormRiskDescription: Potential thunderstorms detected. For safety, avoid cycling during electrical storms.
alerts.heavyRainDescription: Significant rainfall predicted. Road conditions may be hazardous.
alerts.extremeHeatDescription: Temperatures above 35°C predicted. Stay hydrated and consider early morning or evening rides.
alerts.freezingTemperaturesDescription: Sub-zero temperatures expected. Road ice may be present. Use appropriate winter cycling gear.
alerts.airQualityWarningDescription: Current air pollution levels are high. Cycling increases oxygen intake — consider postponing your ride or changing your route.
alerts.strongWindDescription: Strong wind gusts expected (≥30 km/h). Be cautious, especially on exposed sections and bridges.
alerts.iceRiskDescription: Near-freezing temperatures with high humidity or precipitation increase ice risk on roads. Avoid sudden maneuvers.

advice.icyRoad: Ice risk on roads — use winter cycling gear or postpone your ride.
advice.toxicAir: Hazardous air quality — avoid outdoor exercise immediately.
advice.moderateAir: Poor air quality conditions for cycling. Consider postponing or choosing a less polluted route.
advice.heavyRainNow: Heavy rain is falling now. Rain protection recommended for your ride.
advice.highRainRisk: Very high chance of rain in the next few hours. Consider rain gear or rescheduling.
advice.extremeHeat: Extreme heat warning — temperatures above 35°C. Hydrate well and consider riding early morning or evening.
advice.extremeWind: Extreme wind conditions expected (≥40 km/h). Not recommended for cycling safety.
advice.strongWindAdvice: Strong headwind risk (30–39 km/h). Plan your route carefully to minimize exposure.
advice.cold: Cold temperatures below 5°C. Dress in warm layers and protect exposed skin.
advice.perfectConditions: Perfect weather conditions for cycling! Enjoy the ride!
advice.warmHydrate: Warm conditions — stay well hydrated, especially on longer rides.
advice.greatWeather: Great weather for a ride. Enjoy your cycling session!
advice.mixedConditions: Mixed riding conditions today. Use caution and check local forecasts.

error.default: Something went wrong. Please try again.
error.noWeather: Failed to load weather data. Please check your connection and try again.
error.noCityFound: No city found. Try a different search term.
